In my server, I have a reactive function that returns a vector of values:

  reactive_formap_values <- reactive({

    # Grab the data for the right year and the right indicator:
     ... select(Value) %>% unlist
  })

Next, I want to define a function depends on 'reactive_formap_values. I want to use this function going forward. Here is how I've done it:

  formap_palette <- function() {
    colorNumeric(
      palette = c("#fee6ce","#e6550d"),
      domain = reactive_formap_values()  # using the 'reactive_formap_values I created above
    )
  }

Finally, I want to build a map. I already checked the code, and it works (outside of shiny):
(Note: leaflet_map is a correct object that was created in global.R)

  output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
    # Apply the palette function above to provide colors to addPolygons:
    leaflet_map %>%
      addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, smoothFactor = 0.2, fillOpacity = 1,
                  color = ~formap_palette(reactive_formap_values()),         # this is the line that I think causes the error
                  label = my177)
  })

# My map doesn't crash, but instead of the map I am getting the following error in red: unused argument (reactive_formap_values())
# And in my R console I am getting a warning:
Warning: Error in formap_palette: unused argument (reactive_formap_values())

Any pointers how I could fix that function formap_palette? I have a feeling I am defining a function incorrectly...
Thanks a lot!

mymap <- leaflet(countries)
myvalues <- 1:177   # Here, I define myvalues, but in Shiny, I want them to be: reactive_formap_values()
# Create a continuous palette function
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#fee6ce","#e6550d"),
  domain = myvalues)
# Apply the function to provide RGB colors to addPolygons
mymap %>%
  addPolygons(stroke = FALSE, smoothFactor = 0.2, fillOpacity = 1,
              color = ~pal(myvalues))

dear Andrew,
    After migrate your code into my project, there's still blocked problem(verbatinTextOutput becomes blocked after calling importFile()) if it tooks too long(about 2 minutes).
My project uses fileInput to upload excel files, and verbatinTextOutput to display calculate result text.
I write importFile() function in common.R(uses openxlsx to read excel .xlsx files and validate some column and append errors to data.table), and load it in the very begining of server.R
    Besides I uses André le Blond <https://stackoverflow.com/users/3768351/andr%c3%a9-le-blond> 's future solution, still have the blocking problem(reference site https://stackoverflow.com/questions/41610354/calling-a-shiny-javascript-callback-from-within-a-future)
Attach my partial code as belowings~

getFileInput <- eventReactiveAsync(input$fileInput,{
    Sys.sleep(1)
    input$fileInput
  })

  importAndValidate <- function(iFileInput) {
   if (is.null(iFileInput))
      return (NULL)
    # Create a Progress object
    progress <- shiny::Progress$new()
    progress$set(message = "Data Import", value = 0)
    # Close the progress when this reactive exits (even if there's an error)
    on.exit(progress$close())
    # Create a callback function to update progress.
    # Each time this is called:
    # - If `value` is NULL, it will move the progress bar 1/(5*2) of the remaining
    #   distance. If non-NULL, it will set the progress to that value.
    # - It also accepts optional detail text.
    updateProgress <- function(value = NULL, detail = NULL) {
      if (is.null(value)) {
        value <- progress$getValue()
        value <- value + (progress$getMax() - value) / (5 * 2)
      }
      progress$set(value = value, detail = detail)
    }

    uploadType <- input$uploadType
    # import file, and pass in the updateProgress function so
    # that it can update the progress indicator.
    importFile(uploadType, iFileInput, updateProgress)
  }

  output$uploadStatus <- renderText({
    listCallRes <- importAndValidate(getFileInput())
    if (is.null(listCallRes)) return (NULL)
    listCallRes$statusText
  })
